scenario: A crypto exchange compliance analyst reviews a high-value customer withdrawal request. The exchange's fraud-risk policy requires any withdrawal matching an account-takeover (ATO) pattern (new device + new destination wallet + account age under 25 hours) or a layering pattern (deposit-then-immediate-withdraw with no prior withdrawal history) to be held for manual review. The pipeline normalizes the withdrawal request context from a CSV log, computes a withdrawal risk disposition score, then emits a withdrawal release memo (Approve / Hold / Block).
info_flow: ub2-csv-data-analyzer reads and normalizes the withdrawal request CSV (account activity, device/IP signals, destination wallet characterization) → financial-calculator computes a withdrawal risk disposition score from the normalized fields → ub2-markdown-report-generator writes the withdrawal release memo (Approve / Hold / Block) to the output file.
